say:2:1131051002:1.text: It doesn't seem broken, so I think I just need a bit of time.
say:2:1131051002:1.source_cn: 我的腿又没骨折！再过上一会儿，怎么也能恢复个七七八八了。
say:2:1131051002:1.male: It doesn't seem broken, so I think I just need a bit of time.
say:2:1131051002:1.female: It doesn't seem broken, so I think I just need a bit of time.

say:3:1131051003:1.text: My friends are also nearby somewhere. I bet they're looking for me as we speak.
say:3:1131051003:1.source_cn: 而且我同伴就在附近。我突然消失，他们肯定四处找我呢。
say:3:1131051003:1.male: My friends are also nearby somewhere. I bet they're looking for me as we speak.
say:3:1131051003:1.female: My friends are also nearby somewhere. I bet they're looking for me as we speak.

say:4:1131051004:1.text: Think I'll just sit tight and wait for them.
say:4:1131051004:1.source_cn: 我就老实待在这里，等他们来找我吧。
say:4:1131051004:1.male: Think I'll just sit tight and wait for them.
say:4:1131051004:1.female: Think I'll just sit tight and wait for them.
